dorsal_planar_contour_and_symmetry.axial_tapering: Acute linear narrowing of the visible body mass toward the posterior peduncle region.

high_frequency_epidermal_anomalies.localized_point_contrast_disruptions: Fine, light-colored linear streaks consistent with superficial scratches or rake marks across the dorsal plane.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Superficial linear scarring patterns visible on the dorsal surface.
